claims.A5: An old aminx.* class path embedded in a pickle fails to load with ModuleNotFoundError after the rename, and a find_class prefix remap restores loading.

prereg.question: After the package rename, do pickled calibration checkpoints that embed the old module path fail to load, and does a find_class prefix remap fix that without touching unrelated modules?
prereg.expect_if_true: blob_embeds_old_path true; plain_loads_fails true with a ModuleNotFoundError naming oldpkg; remap_loads true; remap_class_module equals newpkg.potts.calibration; remap_leaves_stdlib_alone true.
prereg.expect_if_false: plain_loads_fails false (pickle resolves the old path some other way, so no remap item is needed) or remap_loads false (a find_class remap is insufficient and the checkpoints must be re-serialised).
